summary: 1–4, The Lord names His church The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints; 5–6, Zion and her stakes are places of defense and refuge for the Saints; 7–16, The Saints are commanded to build a house of the Lord at Far West; 17–19, Joseph Smith holds the keys of the kingdom of God on earth.
meta_description: Revelation given through Joseph Smith the Prophet, at Far West, Missouri, April 26, 1838, identifying the name of the Church as The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. The revelation also approved of Far West as a new gathering place in the land of Zion.

footnotes.note3_a: TG Jesus Christ, Head of the Church.
footnotes.note4_b: 1 Cor. 1:10 (10–13); D&C 20:1 (1–4); 136:2 (2–8). TG Kingdom of God, on Earth.
